parameters: My Duke, we have word that there is a massive riot in the streets of Rimorgue!\! The mob is calling for an end to war and they demand compensation!\! Our government has been exiled!
What?!\! Why now?!\! Then we mustn't waste time!\! We must take Fort Eureeka without delay - overwhelm their defenses! Charge!!
So, it's come to this...\! Lysander, how could I have miscalculated this bad...

Don't worry about it. Look at them, they're fools.\! Preparing to charge a position as heavily fortified as this.\! They're throwing lives away... one has to wonder why.\! As long as we control the chokepoints in the walls, Fort Eureeka will hold.
Hopefully they'll take enough damage to lose their appetite for bloodshed...
\c[1]Permadeath has been turned off for this chapter.
TO TERENOR (once anyone talks to him)
Terenor! Stop this!\! You can call it all off and realize you've been mislead.\! Casamir thinks he can wag you around like a dog...\| we musn't give him what he wants!
It is too late for that now, \n[8].\! One of us will die today, so unless you wish to leave this world in disgrace, raise your weapon!
Ugh... you ARE a predictable oaf!\! Fine, then die the lapdog of a traitor!
With Terenor dead... what's going to happen??
A meaningless death.\! But Casamir's still out there.\! We need to stay vigilant!
Oh, Terenor died in battle?\! How unfortunate.\! It seems we will have to clean up this mess now.
Such firepower...\| they lured us to a trap.\! As if they knew we'd be here exactly at this time. How...
Everyone, fall back to the keep!\! Stay out of range of those cannons! Maybe we can hold them off if we stand strong!
Jules...\| we have followed \n[8] into the jaws of Hell...
It is a tough situation indeed, Narima.\! We're still alive, though.
Jules, if it comes down to it, would you die for \n[8]?\! Would you die in this war among squabbling Veridian nobles?
Narima...\| we're all here together.\! I don't want anyone to die, and that includes you and I!\! Why are you so worried about me over the others?
...\| Someday you'll know.\! But not today.\! Today your job is to survive, do you understand?!
Same to you, Narima.\! You've looked out for me so much thus far, so I'm not going to let you throw yourself away either!\! Come on, let us defend this fortress as a true Sayunaari would!
Truly noble in deed... Donar watch over you.
Sybil, you stay sharp out there, y'here me?\! I got a funny feelin' about me now.\! Not a good one.
You goin' soft on us or what?!\! This is what I live for!\! My heart is racing...\| if only I could feel like this all the time.\! It's like there's fire flowing through me!
Listen t'me, kiddo...\| this ain't lookin' pretty.\! I been down this road before.\! You'd should trust this old man's gut feelin' - it's the best friend I got.
...\|Whaddya mean?\! You don't think we'll make it?!
Barnabas...\| How'd such a sweet man end up a soldier anyway?\! Come on, we can do this!\! They'll have to kill me a thousand times before they win!
I'm doin' okay!\! No really... I'm fine!
It seems the enemy has lured us into an impossible situation.\! This may be the end.
...\| Y'always were a bright and sunny personality, Diana.
As you would say, "don't shoot the messenger."
Stefan... this is not the life for you.\! I will not tell the others should you happen to slip away.\! If I fall in battle, I need you to protect my Alex.
...Alright, alright!\! ...Bah, you've always gotta talk about dyin'.\! You may not care if that happens but damn, some of us sure will.

If they do kill me, my body will perish, but they will never see a Paladin on their knees.\! Until such time, do keep count of how many fall to my hammer... and tell the world what it means to go against the Paladins of holy Donar.
Now you're talkin'!\! Come on, let's make a story that'll be burned into memory for a thousand years!
Zelos...\| I couldn't make it.\! Wherever you are, you'll have to make things right...
All this carnage, because I thought I knew what the hell I was doing...
Casamir...\| Someone... something...\| will destroy you.\! Even if I must from the grave...
Stubborn little street rabble. As you wish, we will hold back no longer.\! Commander Trihan, converge on \n[8]'s position with all available forces! Crush them!
